note: Reports OpenAI’s withdrawal of three linked manuscripts on Hodge-type questions for abelian varieties and K3 surfaces after errors (a sign error and a flawed construction used by two dependent papers) that, according to OpenAI, were found during an audit. Includes comment from mathematicians at Cornell and MIT on how the release was handled.
title: OpenAI withdraws three preprints a day after releasing 722 manuscripts on unsolved math problems
